claimBoundary: This ledger records manually reviewed Knip dead-export candidates. It does not authorize deletion, autofix, cleanup completion, release readiness, public readiness, or external validation claims.

records.rationale: Codex OAuth and credential lookup paths are side-effect sensitive and can fail silently if static cleanup removes externally expected helpers.
records.guardrail: Before removal, cover Codex credential lookup with no-secret fixtures and verify redacted error output on missing credentials.

records.rationale: Provider-profile env builders are likely ordinary module exports, but each provider preset may still be referenced by docs or profile bootstrap flows.
records.guardrail: Before removal, run provider profile tests and search docs/bootstrap scripts for provider preset references.

records.rationale: Credential clearing is a destructive-auth-state helper and must not be removed without proving logout and reset behavior still works.
records.guardrail: Before removal, add credential lifecycle tests that prove stored-token clear, missing-token no-op, and no secret logging behavior.

records.rationale: The underscore and testing suffix suggest this is a test-only seam that may be moved into a test helper if no runtime import exists.
records.guardrail: Before removal, run bridge session tests and replace any direct test imports with a local fixture helper.
